subject: ACME: Deployment routing, evaluation plan, and close timeline
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmecorp.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: Initial MAP and timing — hosting vs dedicated vs private

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo today — our team is aligned on the capabilities and we want to formalize a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can pick a deployment path (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and lock down a closing timeline. High level constraints from procurement & infra:

- Production must be in US (primary), with EU region as a compliance fallback.
- Initial POC needs to demonstrate median token latency < 220ms on our workloads.
- Procurement prefers reserved capacity if unit cost delta vs hosted is >30%.
- If Private (on-prem), we need SOC2 evidence and an air-gapped deployment option.

Can you share a simple MAP with milestones (pilot, eval, procurement signoff, go-live) and a 30/60/90 day path? Also attaching our security questionnaire (will send infra contacts after you confirm scope).

Looking to run a pilot end of Feb if feasible.

Thanks —
Sarah Liu
Director, AI Platforms 
ACME Corporation
[Attachment: ACME_Security_Questionnaire.docx (docx, 84KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 16:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Initial MAP and timing — hosting vs dedicated vs private

Hi Sarah — great to meet you too.

Appreciate the constraints — we can definitely put together a tight MAP and a short evaluation plan that tests both performance and unit economics across the three deployment modes. Quick notes:

- We can provision a 3-day dedicated pilot in us-east for latency testing as early as Feb 27; will capture per-token cost and tail latency.
- Hosted option is the fastest to launch (low friction), Dedicated will give predictable throughput and isolation, Private (on-prem/VPC) requires additional time (SOC2 + packaging) — usually adds 4–6 weeks to procurement.
- For EU fallback, we can schedule parallel read-only routing in eu-west for compliance checks during the pilot window.

I attached a first-pass MAP (ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx) with suggested milestones and owners. Can you confirm an internal point of contact for procurement and infra? If Tom/Gary are available next week, we can lock the pilot window.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Director, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 52KB)]

Folks — forwarding the ACME thread and our MAP draft. Key asks we need to cover in the next 48 hrs so we can hit their preferred pilot at the end of the week: 

1) Technical pilot: 3-day Dedicated instance in us-east for latency runs (median and p95). Collect KV cache hit rates and token-level latency. Output: us-east-latency-run-20260227.csv.
2) Cost delta analysis: Hosted vs Dedicated committed Q1 pricing for the expected traffic profile (they estimate ~2M tokens/day during pilot).
3) Private feasibility: If ACME insists on on-prem, what’s the minimum lead time and what SOC2 artifacts can we surface immediately? They called this out as a gating item.
4) EU fallback: small read-only routing test in eu-west so they can validate cross-region compliance.

Please reply inline with owners and any blockers. I copied Rishi for contract/terms input. I’ll coordinate dates with Sarah/Tom.

Thanks —
Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Initial MAP and timing — ACME pilot (need quick input)

Karthik — thanks for the context, copying the key technical points here and calling out what we can deliver quickly:

- Dedicated pilot (us-east): we can spin a 2xA100 pool configured for their expected concurrency and run the 3-day latency test. We will enable continuous batching and KV-prefix cache to reduce token cost during the pilot. (Owner: Platform — Monica)
- Data path: telemetry + token sampling will be captured to the pilot S3 bucket; we will provide a CSV and dashboard link. Expect p50/p95 and tail metrics.
- Hosted comparison: operations can provide a sandbox hosted route with identical model weights to compare head-to-head (Owner: Product).
- Private/on-prem: engineering estimates 4–6 weeks to package an air-gapped installer + hardening for SOC2 requirements. We can provide the SOC2 evidence packet (SOC2 report extract, control matrix) immediately — attaching the standard packet.

Open items: required network access from ACME infra (IP allowlist), data retention settings for the pilot, and whether they need dedicated logging (audit export).

If we get the green light, Monica will own provisioning and I will own the MAP updates and delivery of the comparative cost sheet. Rishi — can you confirm standard contracting lead times for a Dedicated PO vs Hosted subscription?

—Marissa
[Attachment: SOC2_evidence_request.pdf (pdf, 128KB)]
